name: π0-FAST (pi0-FAST)
family: Autoregressive vision-language-action model with the FAST action tokenizer (PaliGemma 3B backbone)

sources.title: K. Pertsch et al., FAST: Efficient Action Tokenization for Vision-Language-Action Models, arXiv:2501.09747 (v1)
sources.covers: the 224 px input, two or three images, chunk lengths, the inference time per chunk, the control rates of the tasks

sources.title: openpi (official code), commit 215abfb: src/openpi/models/pi0_fast.py, model.py, src/openpi/training/config.py, src/openpi/shared/image_tools.py
sources.covers: the shared preprocessing (resize_with_pad to IMAGE_RESOLUTION), the SigLIP variant So400m/14, the default action_horizon

sources.title: L. Beyer et al., PaliGemma: A versatile 3B VLM for transfer, arXiv:2407.07726
sources.covers: image tokens per image at 224 px

note: π0-FAST shares π0's image preprocessing in openpi (aspect-preserving resize to 224 × 224 with centred black padding). The chunk length depends on the configuration: Pi0FASTConfig's default action_horizon is 32, openpi's pi0_fast_droid configuration uses 10, and the paper trains DROID to predict 15-step chunks; set your own with an override. The paper's 750 ms per chunk does not name its GPU, so the timing's hardware is not stated. Code Apache-2.0. DexVantage bundles these figures only, not the model.

input_resolution.quote: Appendix C: "using a resolution of 224x224 pixels" (openpi IMAGE_RESOLUTION = (224, 224))

crop_rule.quote: Pi0FAST calls _model.preprocess_observation, which resizes with image_tools.resize_with_pad ("without distortion by padding with black")

tokens_per_image.quote: 224 px gives 256 image tokens per image (PaliGemma, Section 3.1)

n_cameras.quote: "conditioned on two or three inputs images (one third person camera, and one wrist camera per robot arm)"

action_chunk.quote: Pi0FASTConfig: action_horizon: int = 32 (default); pi0_fast_droid: action_horizon=10; the paper tokenizes "1-second action chunks" and trains DROID to "predict 15-step action chunks"

execute_steps.quote: Not one figure: DROID executes "8 or 15-step chunks open-loop at inference time".

inference_ms.quote: "needs approximately 750ms of inference time per chunk" (Section VI-E; the GPU is not named)

control_hz.quote: Not one figure: 20 Hz (table bussing, grocery bagging), 50 Hz (T-shirt folding, toast, laundry folding), DROID 15 Hz, BridgeV2 5 Hz (Section VI-A, Table I).
